title: UnitRegistryValidator
responsibility: Checks active registry identities, source ownership, declared relationships and reviewed canonical dependency boundaries.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate.manifests
inputs.description: All registry manifests; active entries are validated while retired entries remain available for lineage checks.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate.files
inputs.description: Indexed source paths used to detect missing owned files.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate.sources
inputs.description: Optional indexed source facts; omitted means canonical import checks are unavailable. The CLI supplies this map.

inputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings.identifiers
inputs.description: Active IDs projected by the caller using its existing collection admission behavior.

inputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings.units
inputs.description: Active manifests, including owned sources and canonical runtime entries.

inputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings.sources
inputs.description: Optional indexed source facts for the explicitly reviewed canonical owner cohort; omitted skips dependency inspection.

outputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate
outputs.description: Diagnostics for invalid composition, duplicate identities or source owners, missing sources, helpers, configs, dependencies, lineage and reviewed canonical backedges.

outputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings
outputs.description: Duplicate identity diagnostics and, when sources are supplied, reviewed canonical forwarding backedges or unread-source diagnostics.
